title: Shield of Arrav
start: Talk to Reldo in the Varrock palace library.

rewards.t: If you are a member, you can talk to Historian Minas in the Varrock Museum to receive 5 kudos and an antique lamp that gives 1,000 experience in a skill of level 20 or above.

steps.t: Talk to Reldo in the Varrock Palace library. [Chat: 1 I'm in search of a quest. › Accept]
Search the east side of the centre bookcases (with the navy blue book) for The Shield of Arrav book, then read it.
Talk to Reldo and ask about the Phoenix Gang. [Chat: 1 Do you know where I can find the Phoenix Gang?]

Talk to Baraek who is located in the north-east of Varrock square, and give him 10 coins. Ask him every question available. [Chat: 1 Can you tell me where I can find the Phoenix Gang? › 1 Alright. Have 10 gold coins. › 2 Thanks!]
Travel to the Phoenix Gang Hideout which is located south of Aubury's Rune Shop. It will be marked by a dungeon link to the Misthalin Underground on the map.
Climb down the ladder.
Talk to Straven and ask to join. Tell him you know who he is. [Chat: 1 I know who you are! › 1 I'd like to offer you my services.]
Go to the Blue Moon Inn which is just north of Varrock's southern entrance.
Kill Jonny the beard.
Grab the Intel report that he drops.
Return to the hideout and talk to Straven.
Search the chest in the south-west corner of the hideout for a broken shield.
After climbing back up the ladder, enter the house east of the Phoenix Gang Hideout and go up the ladder there.
Pick up the two Phoenix crossbows on the floor, you will need these for the next gang.

Talk to Charlie the Tramp located just north of Varrock's southern entrance. Ask him what's down the alley. [Chat: 3 Do you know where I can find the Black Arm Gang hideout? › 1 That sounds fair. (Pay 10 gold.)]
Follow the alley to the west and enter the building.

Talk to Katrine. [Chat: 1 I've heard you're the Black Arm Gang. › Any › 1 I want to become a member of your gang. › 1 Well, you can give me a try, can't you? › 1 No problem. I'll get you two phoenix crossbows.]
Talk to Katrine again to give her the crossbows.
Head north through the door and climb up the staircase.
Open and search the cupboard on the south-eastern wall for the other broken shield piece.
Use one half of the shield on the other for a restored shield.
Talk to King Roald located in the immediate east room of the Varrock Palace. [Chat: 1 Talk about the Shield of Arrav.]

sub.t: If you have completed Priest in Peril [Chat: 2 Talk about the Shield of Arrav.]

steps.t: Quest complete!
